tools.description: Edit-ready context for the symbols in terms=[...] (the only retrieval key): one hop through the call graph plus a full-text pass, delivered as line-numbered source windows with callers and a 'tested by' file:line. Do not re-read the files it shows. Size with budget= and max_files=. To merely locate, use prism_search.

context_used.description: Tokens in your context now. Optional.

delivery.description: source = line-numbered windows + callers; symbols = compact list. Default source.

max_files.description: source only: max files shown as windows. Default 5.

model.description: Your model ID; sizes budgets. Optional.

task.description: Label for the response header only.

terms.description: REQUIRED retrieval key, e.g. ["AccessCount"], expanded via the call graph. No name yet? Guess ONE keyword.

tools.name: prism_query

tools.description: Read a file, whole or by line range (offset/limit), line-numbered. A repeat read of an unchanged file returns a `// [prism:cached]` pointer — use the copy you already have. For one function use prism_lookup.

context_used.description: Tokens in your context now. Optional.

file.description: File path relative to project root.

limit.description: Lines from offset. Omit both for the whole file.

model.description: Your model ID; sizes budgets. Optional.

offset.description: First line (1-based); with limit, an exact window.

tools.name: prism_read

tools.description: Locate unknown names or paths: symbol names AND raw text (real rg/grep). Known symbol? Use lookup for bodies or change_impact for affected sites directly. Batch up to 10 terms in query=[...]. scope="text" is pure grep, cheapest — use it wherever you would run grep/rg. Narrow with path=/glob=/files_only. context=N adds the lines around each hit (grep -C) — no follow-up read. exhaustive=true requests full coverage; heed partial-result warnings.

context.description: Lines around each match (grep -C N, max 15) — instead of a follow-up read. Whole function? prism_lookup.

exhaustive.description: Raises text caps to 100000 hits / 10000 per file, symbols to 2000. Deadlines still apply. Partial results are marked; narrow path=/glob= if incomplete.

files_only.description: Paths only, no lines — cheapest "where does this live".

limit.description: Max results (default 25, maximum 2000; non-positive uses default).

path.description: Restrict to repo-relative files/dirs, e.g. "src/" or ["src/","tests/"].

query.description: One term or an array of up to 10 (batch them). Regex when regex=true.

regex.description: Regex for the text pass (invalid → literal).

rollup_only.description: On a truncated search return only hitRollup (grouped counts), no sample lines.

task.description: Optional caller label only; does not affect retrieval or scope and is not echoed in results.

tools.name: prism_search

tools.description: Read whole symbol bodies by qualified name. Batch related methods in name=[...] (up to 10); use name=[{"name":"Type.method","file":"path/to/file"}] for exact per-item file scope. For a small local bug, read the relevant methods together; impact is for affected-site questions. fields=[...] narrows to signature/doc/body/...; omit for whole bodies.

fields.description: Columns to read; omit for the full body.

file.description: Legacy soft path/substring hint for string names; ignored if no candidate matches. Use {name,file} batch items for exact scope.

name.description: One name, or 1-10 strings/{name,file} items. Objects use exact file scope; outer file hints apply only to strings. fields applies to all; oversized results are explicitly omitted with their scopes.

file.description: Exact repo-relative file scope; never widened on a miss.

tools.name: prism_lookup

tools.description: Every site that must change when a symbol does. Pass 'Type.method' and get, in one call: declarations, the full override/implementation family, breaking sibling contracts (supers), all resolved callers, and declaringTypes. Reach for this before a signature change or affected-site enumeration. Includes signatures, test labels, and bounded matching call expressions so those facts do not need separate lookups. Read bodies only for behavior or evidence gaps, not routinely for site enumeration. 'partial' means coverage gaps; follow coverageNote. 'closed' describes indexed scope, not heuristic receiver certainty. 'project-local' + overridesExternal = the method implements an external contract whose signature must not change. Relay the set as-is — re-filtering through grep drops real sites.

context_used.description: Tokens in your context now. Optional.

file.description: Disambiguate same-named types in different packages: only types declared in a file whose path contains this seed the closure (change_impact only; the result says when this is needed).

model.description: Your model ID; sizes budgets. Optional.

query.description: Type.method or Type.method(ParamType, ...) — e.g. "JsonSerializer.serialize(T, JsonGenerator, SerializerProvider)". A bare member name ("serialize") or file:line ("src/Foo.java:120") also works when it resolves to exactly one symbol; if several match, the error lists the candidates.

tools.name: prism_change_impact

base.description: Git ref to diff the working tree against (default "HEAD"). The change-set is computed relative to this.

removed_symbols.description: MID-LOOP fast path: instead of the full diff gate, report every remaining reference to each listed removed identifier (exhaustive, comments/docs included) — one call replacing the repeated per-identifier greps of a removal task. Run the plain (no-arg) verify before declaring the change done.
